name: atml-file-manager
description: Browse SystemLink files, render ATML (IEEE 1671/1636) test results in a readable summary and step tree, and import ATML files as native Test Monitor results.

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build && node ../../scripts/build-plugin-package.mjs . && node ../../scripts/verify-plugin-package.mjs .
scripts.sbom: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('sbom',{recursive:true})" && npm run sbom:cyclonedx && npm run sbom:spdx
